_comment: Alaska has no state income tax on wages.
name: Alaska
notes: Alaska has no state income tax and no statewide sales tax (some towns add their own).
Alaska is one of the few states where employees pay into state unemployment insurance, so a small amount is withheld from each check.
The Permanent Fund Dividend isn't taxed by Alaska, but it does count as income on your federal return.
notIncluded: This estimate leaves out Alaska's employee unemployment insurance contribution, which is a small slice of each check.
